topic: Intellectual Property and a Sustainable Future
title: Intellectual Property and a Sustainable Future
session_title: Intellectual Property for Practicing Engineers: Patents and Trade Secrets
abstract: As climate change continues to affect the world, industries of all kind are developing new ways to increase their sustainability and decrease their carbon footprint. This green revolution has led to a variety of new proprietary technologies being brought to the market. With the increase in new sustainable technology, the necessity for intellectual property continues to rise. Although companies need to protect their IP rights, there is also a need to allow other companies to help the world become more sustainable. Thus, companies must balance the need to protect IP rights and the need to share their technologies. This presentation will provide an overview of the basics of IP, how IP is at the forefront of sustainable technology, and important considerations for members of industry, academics, and anyone with an idea for a green invention. Speakers will also highlight several case studies addressing sustainable IP and whether the IP was strong enough.

topic: How emerging growth companies can effectively protect their intellectual assets
title: How emerging growth companies can effectively protect their intellectual assets
session_title: Intellectual Property for Practicing Engineers: Patents and Trade Secrets
abstract: The discussion will include a general overview of intellectual property rights and why they are important for emerging growth companies (e.g., entrepreneurs, start-ups, university spin-outs) in the life sciences sector to consider early in the life of the company. The discussion will particularly focus on how to determine if a patent application is an appropriate means of protection for the emerging growth company and how to effectively pursue a patent application. The discussion will include steps an emerging growth company can perform on their own without having to involve an outside consultant (e.g., attorney). The discussion will include common pitfalls when obtaining intellectual property rights and creative ways emerging growth companies can enforce their rights to deter competition or generate revenue (e.g., licensing).

authors: Robert Sovesky | K&L Gates LLP, Pittsburgh, PA
